item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01810","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan’s share, omitting Chris’s withdrawal.","case2_error":"Reports individual daily bird counts without calculating the requested three-day total.","reason":"The first omits a required withdrawal; the second supplies daily quantities instead of their requested aggregate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01811","case1_error":"Evaluates 80 − 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final answer of 300 after a correct procedure that yields 200.","reason":"The first explicitly miscalculates a written expression; the second shows no numerical calculation explaining its incorrect final number.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01812","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final answers of 12,000 after correctly writing a formula that yields 23,248.","case2_error":"Includes the stationary break in time multiplied by driving speed.","reason":"The first has a correct formula followed by an unsupported number; the second uses an erroneous distance relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01813","case1_error":"Omits Saturday’s ten additional rounds from the weekend total.","case2_error":"Doubles only the first day’s five shells instead of the combined first two days’ twelve shells.","reason":"The first leaves out an activity’s contribution to the total; the second uses the wrong base for a doubling relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01814","case1_error":"Uses full-price primer costs, ignoring the stated 20% discount.","case2_error":"Evaluates 2,250,000 × 0.02 as 450,000 instead of 45,000.","reason":"The first omits a required price adjustment; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written cost expression.","judgment":"different"}]}
